method_definition: PURI-GS-RU-v1 is the gsplat v1.5.3 DefaultStrategy B1 baseline with AbsGrad enabled at grow_grad2d=0.0006, augmented during training by a frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14-register feature extractor, a 384-16-1 static-mask MLP, RobustSplat-style residual/feature mask supervision, a 16-to-36 scale cascade, and delayed Gaussian refinement from step 10000 through 19999. The exported Gaussian checkpoint and inference path do not load DINOv2 or the mask head.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Uses absolute screen-space positional gradient magnitudes to drive the stock gsplat duplicate/split decision.
changes.adaptation_description: B1 selects gsplat's built-in AbsGrad mode and fixes grow_grad2d to 0.0006; RU preserves it.
changes.license_note: gsplat is Apache-2.0; cite AbsGS for the absolute-gradient rule.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Extracts frozen x_norm_patchtokens from DINOv2 ViT-S/14 with registers on 224 and 504 pixel square inputs.
changes.adaptation_description: Loads a pinned local repository and weight file, applies one shared normalization path, freezes all parameters, and records SHA/commit metadata.
changes.license_note: DINOv2 code and standard model weights are Apache-2.0 at the pinned repository state.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Point-wise Linear(384,16)-ReLU-Linear(16,1)-Sigmoid predictor with Adam learning rate 1e-3.
changes.source_paper_or_repository: RobustSplat utils/mask_utils.py MLPModel; upstream lineage to SpotLessSplats SpotLessModule
changes.adaptation_description: Preserves the 384-16-1 architecture and value-only .data regularizer, refactored for batched BCHW feature grids.
changes.license_note: RobustSplat repository carries the Gaussian-Splatting research/non-commercial license; SpotLessSplats is Apache-2.0.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Accumulates H_t=0.95 H_{t-1}+hist(residual), reads 0.60/0.80 quantiles, and expands inliers with a strict 3x3 majority-or-center rule.
changes.source_paper_or_repository: RobustSplat utils/mask_utils.py calculate_residual_mask/generate_mask; derived there from SpotLessSplats robust masking
changes.adaptation_description: Moves the histogram to CPU and wraps validation/state serialization without changing the accumulation or thresholds.
changes.license_note: Attribution to both RobustSplat and SpotLessSplats is required; review redistribution terms before release.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Forms clamp(2*cos(f_gt,f_render)-1,0,1) as the static target.
changes.adaptation_description: Uses explicit normalization and detached BCHW tensors.
changes.license_note: RobustSplat attribution and license review required.

changes.module_name: Hard static mask and masked photo loss
changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: After step 500 thresholds the MLP at 0.25, erodes with a 7x7 min-pool, and applies unnormalized masked L1 plus masked DSSIM.
changes.source_paper_or_repository: RobustSplat train.py lines implementing threshold, 7x7 erosion, masked L1 and SSIM
changes.adaptation_description: Adapts CHW reference operations to gsplat BCHW/BHWC and fused-SSIM interfaces.
changes.license_note: RobustSplat attribution and license review required.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Optimizes 0.5 L_cos + 0.5 L_residual + 2 exp(-step/2000) mean(1-mask) plus the value-only max-weight regularizer.
changes.adaptation_description: Separates components for diagnostics and enforces gradient isolation; the objective values are preserved.
changes.license_note: RobustSplat attribution and license review required.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Uses 16x16 patch features before step 20000 and 36x36 features afterwards; early render features come from an extra 224x224 rasterization.
changes.adaptation_description: Uses scaled intrinsics in gsplat instead of a separate downsampled camera. Unlike the reference early branch, RU keeps residual evidence at full resolution while only DINO render features use the coarse rasterization.
changes.license_note: RobustSplat attribution and license review required.

changes.module_name: Delayed AbsGrad refinement and opacity reset
changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Accumulates stock gsplat statistics from step 0, allows duplicate/split/prune at 100-step intervals in [10000,20000), resets opacity at 15000 and 18000, then freezes topology.
changes.source_paper_or_repository: RobustSplat delayed Gaussian growth; gsplat DefaultStrategy; AbsGS
changes.adaptation_description: Ports RobustSplat timing into a gsplat DefaultStrategy subclass and combines it with B1 AbsGrad/grow_grad2d=0.0006. The first allowed refine is step 10000 in this zero-based implementation.
changes.license_note: The gsplat subclass is Apache-2.0-based, while the timing behavior is RobustSplat-derived and needs attribution/license review.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Pauses head updates for steps 15001-15300 and 18001-18300 while Gaussian training continues.
changes.adaptation_description: Makes the pause explicit and inclusive for 300 post-reset zero-based steps; the reference condition is not byte-for-byte identical.
changes.license_note: RobustSplat attribution and license review required.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Calls the inherited gsplat DefaultStrategy opacity/scale pruning only during the delayed refinement window.
changes.exact_copy_or_adaptation: inherited stock operation with changed schedule
changes.adaptation_description: SpotLessSplats utilization-based pruning (UBP) is absent: no squared-gradient statistic, UBP rasterizer flag, or ubp_thresh exists in RU.
changes.license_note: gsplat is Apache-2.0; do not describe RU as using SpotLessSplats UBP.

changes.module_name: Detached two-optimizer training and gradient isolation
changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Detaches the hard mask from the Gaussian photo gradient and detaches rendered RGB from the mask/DINO gradient, then validates that no cross-optimizer gradient leaked.
changes.adaptation_description: Implements explicit runtime gradient-contract checks and separate optimizer order in gsplat.
changes.license_note: Engineering code is project-authored, but the supervised objective it integrates remains RobustSplat-derived.

changes.module_name: Offline GT feature cache and inference-only Gaussian checkpoint
changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Caches frozen GT feature grids with SHA validation, saves mask state separately, and evaluates a standard splats-only checkpoint without DINO/head imports.
changes.adaptation_description: Avoids repeated feature extraction and guarantees zero RU auxiliary inference path.
changes.license_note: No new algorithmic novelty claim; document as implementation and reproducibility engineering.

changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Clamps only the detached render copy consumed by DINO to [0,1].
changes.adaptation_description: Does not change the Gaussian photo loss or GT cache; it only satisfies the feature-extractor input contract.
changes.license_note: Engineering safeguard, not an algorithmic contribution.

changes.module_name: RU diagnostics and independent inference validation
changes.function_or_class: record, save_auxiliary, save_visuals, eval validation output
changes.mathematical_or_algorithmic_behavior: Records curves, timing, validation and representative images without changing the optimized Gaussian checkpoint.
changes.adaptation_description: Adds reproducibility evidence and verifies the standard inference path.

excluded_modules.spotlesssplats_ubp: Not implemented or enabled. RU contains no ubp flag, squared-gradient accumulator, or utilization threshold.

training.note: Ratios are archived Phase-R observations and are not a new gate.

inference.note: No algorithmic RU inference overhead; checkpoint compactness changes rasterization cost.

allowed: A gsplat v1.5.3/AbsGrad adaptation and controlled evaluation of a frozen RobustSplat-derived training recipe.
Project-specific engineering for offline DINO caching, explicit gradient isolation, standard-checkpoint inference separation, and strict paired efficiency auditing.
Empirical findings only after the new Android, Garden and On-the-go protocols pass.
not_allowed: Claiming the DINO mask MLP, residual histogram supervision, 16-to-36 cascade, 0.25/7x7 masked loss, or delayed 10k Gaussian growth as PURI-GS original inventions.
Claiming SpotLessSplats UBP is part of RU.
Claiming a new uncertainty method or inference-time robustness module.
Claiming a generally robust backbone before all required gates pass.

license_audit.finding: The project root LICENSE is MIT, but the closest upstream implementation for several RU components is RobustSplat, whose repository carries the Gaussian-Splatting research/non-commercial license. Current RU source files do not contain component-level upstream attribution headers.
license_audit.required_action: Before paper code release or any external redistribution, add explicit RobustSplat/SpotLessSplats/DINOv2/AbsGS attribution and obtain a maintainer/legal determination of whether the local reimplementation is derivative code subject to the RobustSplat repository license. Do not represent the current root MIT file as resolving that question.
